en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large multi-storey castle complex seen from a wooded vantage point. The building has steep gabled roofs, many regular windows, and a small tower or spire rising from the center. Forest and trees frame the foreground, with open countryside visible in the background. The title "Schloss Nossen." is printed in red at the top, and a publisher's imprint appears in red at the bottom right.
